answers.core: It really completes Open scene in Editor. In fact, it's common in applications to have Reveal and Open commands side-by-side.
answers.workaround:
The best is to hover the node, read the path and search it manually.

We could also write a script using `get_scene_file_path` [doc](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/4.2/classes/class_node.html#class-node-property-scene-file-path) but I'm not sure about the API to reveal a resource in FileSystem, nor to add a contextual menu item.

title: Add Scene Tree contextual menu or Inspector button to reveal Scene asset in the FileSystem, from either scene instance or Scene edit view
